ui_dialogs.about.a_betutipusok_a_program: The fonts are built into the program and are never downloaded. The SIL Open Font License 1.1 freely allows using and redistributing them; the licence text is in the source tree (ride-ui-kit/assets/fonts/OFL.txt) and in NOTICE.md.
ui_dialogs.about.a_bike_osm_ride_sajat_k: The code of bike-osm-ride itself is dual-licensed: MIT or Apache-2.0, as you prefer (SPDX: MIT OR Apache-2.0). The full text is in LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE. Contributions come in under the same two licences.
ui_dialogs.about.a_szoftver_ahogy_van_al: The software is provided “as is”, without warranty. Controlling a device (the automatic adjustment of the trainer's resistance) is at your own risk.
ui_dialogs.about.a_teljes_automatikusan_: the complete, automatically generated list: THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md
ui_dialogs.about.a_terkep_alapja_a_sotet: the base of the map; the dark/light style is filtered locally, with no API key
ui_dialogs.about.az_alkalmazas_mukodes_k: While it runs, the app calls these services; the data may be used under their own terms, and the map shows the required attributions. Our licence does not cover that data.
ui_dialogs.about.bluetooth_ftms_okos_tra: Encoding and decoding Bluetooth FTMS (smart trainer) data and control commands
ui_dialogs.about.bongeszo_panel_a_telepi: the Browser panel: the window of the Firefox installed on the computer is embedded, with its own profile (not included in the program)
ui_dialogs.about.csak_akkor_ha_te_bekapc: only when you switch it on and enter your own API key. Google's terms apply to the use, and the requests count against your quota. Images are downloaded and stored (for at most 30 days) only when you switch it on and start the download; panorama ids are stored only if you allow that too.
ui_dialogs.about.dioxus_btleplug_tokio_q: Dioxus, btleplug, tokio, quick-xml and the rest of the Rust dependencies
ui_dialogs.about.edzesleirasok_sajat_szo: the built-in workout library: our own text, written from public training protocols and sports-science studies; the sources of each workout are in the sources field of workouts.json
ui_dialogs.about.opcionalis_utcakep_a_sa: optional Street View with your own API key, under Google's terms; images are downloaded only on request
ui_dialogs.about.pulzusmero_kereses_es_u: the pattern of scanning for a heart rate monitor and reconnecting to it
ui_dialogs.about.szamok_es_cimsorok_ugya: numbers and headings (the same family, condensed cut)
ui_dialogs.about.szandekosan_csak_megeng: We deliberately use only permissively licensed code; the origin is preserved in the source files and in NOTICE.md. No code from a GPL/AGPL project is used.
ui_dialogs.about.szovegbetutipus_the_bar: text typeface (The Barlow Project Authors; built into the program, so it works without an internet connection)
ui_dialogs.about.teljesitmenymero_kadenc: parsing power-meter, cadence and heart-rate sensor data (built-in parts)
ui_dialogs.about.trainer_kapcsolat_es_pa: trainer connection and command safety filter (ported parts)
ui_dialogs.about.utvonaltervezes_bikerou: route planning from a bikerouter link (brouter.de)
ui_dialogs.about.virtualis_tekeres_gpx_u: Virtual riding on GPX routes with a smart trainer or a simulated rider. 2D only: a map, an elevation profile and the trainer's data.
ui_dialogs.about.zwift_click_kulcscsere_: the Zwift Click key exchange (ECDH P-256, HKDF-SHA256) and the AES-CCM encryption
ui_dialogs.about.zwift_click_play_es_hub: Zwift Click/Play and Zwift Hub BLE protocol (ported to Rust), the zwift module of ride-ble
ui_dialogs.devices.az_egesz_eszkoz_leval: Disconnect the whole device (all of its roles)
ui_dialogs.devices.ellenorizd_hogy_be_va: Check that Bluetooth is on, then start a scan.
ui_dialogs.devices.found_count_talalat_e: {found_count} found – one device can fill several roles.
ui_dialogs.devices.hardver_nelkul_a_szim: Without hardware you can try it with the simulated rider.
ui_dialogs.devices.indits_keresest_a_koz: Start a scan to discover nearby devices.
ui_dialogs.devices.ugyanaz_az_eszkoz_tob: The same device fills several roles
ui_dialogs.helpers.a_gpx_be_irt_menet_id: The ride written into the GPX takes {time}. That ghost comes from the file's timestamps, even without a saved ride of your own.
ui_dialogs.helpers.a_kulcs_alakja_rendbe: The key looks well-formed. Whether it really works shows up on the first request.
ui_dialogs.helpers.a_kulcs_csak_betut_sz: The key may contain only letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
ui_dialogs.helpers.a_linkbol_hianyzik_az: The link has no route in it (lonlats=…). Open the route on bikerouter.de and copy the link from there.
ui_dialogs.helpers.a_szellem_ki_van_kapc: The ghost is switched off. Segment PR times are still shown.
ui_dialogs.helpers.ebben_a_gpx_ben_nincs: This GPX has no timestamps (no <time>), so the route's own time cannot be replayed.
ui_dialogs.helpers.ehhez_az_utvonalhoz_m: There is no saved ride on this route yet. The GPX's own time is {time}: choose the “Route time” mode and you have a ghost already.
There is no saved ride on this route yet. After the first finished ride (at least 1 minute and 200 m) the ghost waits at the start line.
ui_dialogs.helpers.ez_nem_bikerouter_de_: This is not a bikerouter.de link. Paste a link copied with bikerouter.de's “Share” button.
ui_dialogs.helpers.illessz_be_egy_bikero: Paste a bikerouter.de link, or open a GPX file.
ui_dialogs.helpers.illeszd_be_a_sajat_go: Paste your own Google Maps API key. Without a key there is no Street View.
ui_dialogs.helpers.rides_a_legutobbi_nem: {rides}; the latest one did not finish: the ghost replays it and stops where it stopped.
ui_dialogs.helpers.rides_a_szellem_a_kov: {rides}. The ghost waits at the start line on your next ride.
ui_dialogs.helpers.rides_de_egyik_sem_er: {rides}, but none of them finished: the ghost replays the one that got furthest and stops where that one stopped.
ui_dialogs.helpers.rides_de_egyik_sem_in: {rides}, but none of them started from the start line, so none can be a ghost. Start a ride from the start line, or choose the “Route time” mode.
ui_dialogs.helpers.rides_de_mind_szimula: {rides}, but all of them are simulated. The “Best” ghost can only be a real ride: choose the “Last ride” mode.
ui_dialogs.helpers.rides_ebbol_szimulalt: {rides} ({simulated} of them simulated). The ghost waits at the start line on your next ride.
ui_dialogs.helpers.szokatlan_kulcs_a_goo: Unusual key: Google API keys usually start with “AIza” and are 39 characters long.
ui_dialogs.helpers.tolts_be_egy_utvonala: Load a route: the ghost comes from earlier rides on that route.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_es_billentyuvel_va: Shift with the ← and → keys or from the Gears panel; a gear changes the trainer's resistance by about ±5 %.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_fizikai_modell_a_s: The basis of the physics model, the speed calculation and the zones.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_fizikai_modell_hel: Show the speed the trainer reports instead of the physics model.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_hitelesito_adatok_: Create an API key on the Credentials page and restrict it to these two APIs.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_kerekpar_tomege_a_: The mass of the bike; the model uses it together with your body weight.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_korabbi_ugyanezen_: Replaying an earlier ride on the same route on the map and the profile, with the lead or deficit measured in seconds. “Best” is the complete ride with the smallest time; simulated rides are never a PR. “Route time” replays the loaded GPX's own timestamps, even without a saved ride.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_letoltott_kepek_le: Downloaded images stay on this machine for at most 30 days.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_mentesben_levo_utv: The routes, rides and workouts in the backup are added to the existing ones: nothing is deleted and nothing is overwritten. Your settings, however, will come from the backup (your Street View key stays). You cannot restore during a ride.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_panel_letoltes_gom: The Download button in the panel saves the route's images, so next time they show up without an API key and without a network.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_paneleket_a_fejlec: Drag the panels by their header: drop one on the edge of another panel and they share its place, drop it on the middle and they swap. Drag the dividers to resize them; they always fill the screen. Closed panels wait in the top bar. The app remembers the layout separately for when a workout is selected and when it is not: until you change it during a workout, the workout layout follows the free-ride one.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_pulzuszonak_felso_: The upper limit of the heart rate zones.
ui_dialogs.settings.a_terkep_kovesse_a_k: Follow the rider on the map
ui_dialogs.settings.a_valodi_meredekseg_: The trainer gets this percentage of the real gradient (0 % = always flat).
ui_dialogs.settings.az_api_library_oldal: In the API Library, enable the two services:
ui_dialogs.settings.az_automatikus_a_kes: Automatic uses the device's language when it is supported; otherwise the app starts in Hungarian.
ui_dialogs.settings.az_utvonalak_a_mente: The routes, the saved rides, the imported workouts and the settings go into a single zip file, on this machine: nothing leaves over the network. The Street View key, the map tiles and the downloaded images are not in it.
ui_dialogs.settings.ban_es_kapcsold_be_a: and switch on billing (Google gives a monthly free tier; see their page for the prices).
ui_dialogs.settings.biztosan_torlod_a_le: Delete the downloaded images? Getting them again uses your own Google quota.
ui_dialogs.settings.csak_a_bekapcsolt_of: Only the offline option, when it is on, uses them, and only without a key or when the live view cannot be loaded: Google serves at most a 640 × 640 pixel image, so live you see the full-resolution embedded view. Google's terms restrict storing Street View images permanently: the download is your decision, and it uses your own Google account's quota.
ui_dialogs.settings.csak_eloretekinto_ne: Only matters in the look-ahead view.
ui_dialogs.settings.google_utcakep_ott_a: Google Street View where you are riding, with your own API key. Without a key no image appears; the requests count against your Google quota.
ui_dialogs.settings.gordulesi_ellenallas: Rolling resistance coefficient (Crr): about 0.004 on good asphalt.
ui_dialogs.settings.ismetelt_tekeresnel_: A repeated ride needs fewer lookups, so you use less quota.
ui_dialogs.settings.kikapcsolva_szabadon: When it is off the map can be moved freely (M).
ui_dialogs.settings.kis_ablak_a_terkep_j: A small window in the bottom right corner of the map; the title-bar button or the V key switches it too, and X swaps the two.
ui_dialogs.settings.kuszobteljesitmeny_a: Threshold power for the zones and the TSS.
ui_dialogs.settings.legellenallasi_felul: Drag area (CdA): about 0.32 in a racing position, about 0.40 sitting upright.
ui_dialogs.settings.masold_ide_a_kulcsot: Paste the key here. It lives only on this machine, in the settings file, and goes only to Google.
ui_dialogs.settings.mennyire_erzodjenek_: How strongly the real climbs should be felt on the trainer.
ui_dialogs.settings.minden_szoveg_es_sza: The size of all text and numbers; worth adjusting on a small or a large display (100 % is the base size). The size of the panels comes from the layout, so larger text may need a larger panel.
ui_dialogs.settings.panorama_azonositok_: Save panorama ids for the route
ui_dialogs.settings.street_view_kepek_le: Download Street View images (for riding without a network)
ui_dialogs.settings.street_view_megjelen: Show Street View on the map
ui_dialogs.summary.a_tura_befejezese_uta: The data appears here once the ride is over.
ui_dialogs.summary.ehhez_az_utvonalhoz_m: There is no earlier ride on this route yet, so there is no ghost comparison. On your next ride this one rides ahead of you as a ghost.
ui_dialogs.summary.szimulalt_menet_nem_s: A simulated ride – it is not a PR, and it does not join the ghosts either.
ui_dialogs.virtual_rider.ennyi_wattot_te: The simulated rider pedals this many watts.
ui_dialogs.welcome.a_bikerouter_de_megos: The “Share” link of bikerouter.de carries the route (lonlats=…).
ui_dialogs.welcome.a_gpx_fajlt_az_ablakr: You can also open the GPX file by dropping it on the window (Ctrl+O). The window closes once it is loaded.
ui_dialogs.welcome.a_vagolap_nem_olvasha: The clipboard cannot be read. Paste the link here with Ctrl+V.
ui_dialogs.welcome.az_itt_megnyitott_gpx: GPX files opened here end up in this list automatically.
ui_dialogs.welcome.ervenyes_bikerouter_l: A valid bikerouter link, it can be loaded.
ui_dialogs.welcome.huzd_ide_a_fajlt_vagy: Drop the file here, or choose it from your machine.
ui_dialogs.welcome.meg_nincs_legutobbi_u: There are no recent routes yet.
ui_dialogs.welcome.rovid_dombos_budapest: A short, hilly loop around Budapest to try it out
A short, hilly loop around Budapest to try it out, no hardware needed.
ui_dialogs.welcome.tervezz_utvonalat_a_b: Plan a route on bikerouter.de, then paste the share link here.
ui_dialogs.welcome.valassz_gpx_fajlt_ill: Choose a GPX file, paste a bikerouter link, or carry on with an earlier route.
ui_dialogs.workouts.a_celwattok_az_ftp_b: The target watts are calculated from FTP (Settings → FTP) and the trainer holds them in ERG mode. Your own workout: a MyWhoosh / Zwift file (XML, ZWO, JSON).
ui_dialogs.workouts.ebben_a_kategoriaban: There is no workout matching the tags in this category. Choose the “All” view, or remove a tag.
ui_dialogs.workouts.mywhoosh_zwift_edzes: Import a MyWhoosh / Zwift workout file (XML, ZWO, JSON)
ui_dialogs.workouts.valassz_egy_edzest_a: Choose a workout from the list, or ride freely.
ui_hud.climb_summary_ahead: {title}, {cat_label}: {hero} {hero_unit}, {length} km long, {grade} % average gradient, +{gain} m of climbing
ui_hud.climb_summary_inside: {title}, {cat_label}: {length} km long, {grade} % average gradient, {hero} km and +{remaining_gain} m to go, {pct} % done
ui_hud.dash.csatlakoztass_eszkozt_az_esz: Connect a device in the Devices window.
ui_hud.nincs_aktiv_edzes_az_utvonal_beto: No active workout. The selected workout starts once a route is loaded.
ui_hud.nincs_tobb_emelkedo_az_utvonalon: There are no more climbs on the route.
ui_map.tolts_be_egy_gpx_fajlt_vagy_illes: Load a GPX file or paste a bikerouter link.
ui_profile.az_utvonal_nem_tartalmaz_eleg: The route does not have enough points for an elevation profile.
ui_profile.magassagi_profil_km_m_szintem: Elevation profile: {km} km, {gain} m of climbing, {climbs} climbs.
ui_profile.meg_nincs_adat_a_grafikonon: There is no data on the chart yet.
ui_profile.nyiss_meg_egy_gpx_fajlt_vagy_: Open a GPX file or paste a bikerouter link.
ui_profile.workout.az_edzes_gombbal_vala: Pick one with the Workout button in the top bar.
ui_review.a_cda_t_a_hajtaslanc_hatasfoka: CdA, drivetrain efficiency and air density always come from the Settings.
ui_review.a_fajlban_nem_volt_teljesitmen: The file carried no power data, so we ran the simulation's physics backwards: from the speed and the gradient we calculated how many watts it would have taken. Without wind and drafting this is an approximation, and the bike's and the rider's data matter a lot.
ui_review.a_jelu_watt_ertekek_becsultek_: Values marked ~ are estimates: they were derived backwards from the speed and the gradient.
ui_review.a_kijelolt_edzeseknek_nincs_ko: The selected rides have no common section. Select a section that each of them touches.
ui_review.a_kijelolt_szakaszt_nem_erinte: No ride covered the whole selected section.
ui_review.a_teljes_utvonal_magassagi_pro: The elevation profile of the whole route
ui_review.az_edzesek_a_befejezesuk_utan_: Rides appear here once they are finished. You can also import a GPX or TCX file exported from another app (Strava, for instance).
ui_review.ehhez_a_metrikahoz_nincs_adat_: There is no data for this metric in the selected rides.
ui_review.ennek_az_utvonalnak_a_fajlja_m: The file of this route is no longer available, so the map and the profile cannot be drawn. Load it again in the Route window.
ui_review.ezt_a_szakaszt_az_edzes_nem_er: The ride did not cover the whole section.
ui_review.huzd_vegig_az_egeret_vagy_az_u: Drag the mouse (or your finger) along the profile or the chart to select a section.
ui_review.jelolj_ki_egy_vagy_tobb_edzest: Select one or more rides in the list.
ui_review.jelolj_ki_legalabb_egy_edzest_: Select at least one ride in the list.
ui_review.jo_aszfalton_kb_0_004_kavicsos: About 0.004 on good asphalt. There is no separate model for gravel.
ui_review.legfeljebb_negy_edzest_lehet_e: At most four rides can be compared at once.
ui_review.most_chart_hu_current_rider_kg: Now: {rider} kg rider + {bike} kg bike, Crr {crr}
ui_review.power.a_jelu_ertekek_becsult_v: Values marked ~ come from estimated or simulated watts, so they never make it into the bests.
ui_review.power.a_legjobb_20_perced_esti: Your best 20 minutes were {w} W ({when}); 95 % of that is the estimated FTP.
ui_review.power.a_legjobb_atlagos_watt_a: The best average watts for the given duration across all your measured rides. A shorter ride has no value for a longer duration.
ui_review.power.analysis_now_rides_pendi: The numbers of {n} older rides are not there yet; they are worked out on the next refresh.
ui_review.power.az_utolso_buckets_len_pe: The last {n} {period}: {rides} rides, {time}, TSS {tss}. The bar shows the TSS; simulated rides do not count, and for rides with estimated watts the time counts but their TSS does not.
ui_review.power.csak_mert_watt_szamit_a_: Only measured watts count. The trainer's own watts are not a power meter, so the suggestion is only as accurate as that. You set the FTP; the app never does it by itself.
ui_review.power.meg_nincs_20_perces_mert: There is no measured 20-minute power yet. The “FTP test 20 minutes” workout helps, or ride (import) at least 20 minutes in one go, as hard as you can.
ui_review.power.meg_nincs_mert_teljesitm: There is no ride with measured power yet. The simulated rider and the estimated (~) watts do not count.
ui_streetview.error.a_google_atmenetileg: Google is not answering right now
ui_streetview.error.a_street_view_csak_a: Street View only talks to Google's services.
ui_streetview.error.ellenorizd_az_intern: Check the internet connection; we retry automatically in a moment.
ui_streetview.error.ellenorizd_hogy_a_ku: Check that the key is right, that the Maps Embed API and the Street View Static API are enabled in the project, that billing is switched on, and that the key's restrictions do not block these.
ui_streetview.error.ezen_a_szakaszon_nin: There is no Street View coverage on this section.
ui_streetview.error.hamarosan_automatiku: We retry automatically in a moment.
ui_streetview.error.hozz_letre_api_kulcs: Create an API key in the Google Cloud console, enable the Maps Embed API and the Street View Static API, then paste the key into the Settings.
ui_streetview.error.probald_kesobb_vagy_: Try later, or raise the quota in the Google Cloud console. With the panorama ids saved, repeated rides need no new lookups.
ui_streetview.error.valoszinuleg_hibas_a: The key's format is probably wrong. Paste it again in the Settings.
ui_streetview.mock.div_class_deny_ez_az_: This page could not load Google Maps properly.
ui_streetview.panel.a_google_street_view: Loading the Google Street View imagery.
ui_streetview.panel.ez_a_szakasz_meg_nin: This section is not downloaded yet
ui_streetview.panel.inditsd_el_a_kepek_l: Start the image download with the button in the header: after that you can ride this route with no Google request and no API key.
ui_streetview.panel.street_view_kepek_le: Download Street View images for the route
ui_streetview.panel.terkep_es_street_vie: Swap the map and Street View (Street View becomes the large one)
Swap the map and Street View (the map becomes the large one)
ui_streetview.panel.tolts_be_egy_utvonal: Load a route for Street View.
app.updater.checksum_failed: The downloaded update checksum is invalid or missing.
app.updater.network_failed: The update could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection.
app.updater.file_failed: The update files could not be saved or replaced.
ui_streetview.error.storage_hint: Check free disk space and write permissions, then restart the download.
ui_dialogs.settings.enable_apis: In the API Library, enable the two services: Maps Embed API and Street View Static API.
ui_dialogs.settings.cloud_project: Open a project in the Google Cloud Console and switch on billing (Google gives a monthly free tier; see their page for the prices).
ui_dialogs.about.streetview_notice: Google Maps Platform / Street View: only when you switch it on and enter your own API key. Google's terms apply to the use, and the requests count against your quota. Images are downloaded and stored (for at most 30 days) only when you switch it on and start the download; panorama ids are stored only if you allow that too.
route.import.implausible_average_speed: The ride has an implausible average speed. Check its timestamps.
app.wake.screen_flag_failed: Could not apply the keep-screen-on setting.
